items.title: Synthetic Agents Learn Evidence Discipline
items.content: We introduce a synthetic benchmark for agent memory intake where captured artifacts become evidence before any memory claim is promoted.

items.title: Append Only Ledgers for Tool Traces
items.content: This paper studies append-only ledgers for tool traces and evaluates anti-echo folding across repeated captures.

items.title: Routing Evidence Without Promoting Truth
items.content: We describe a route-evidence workflow that records observations separately from durable adjudicated truth.
